characters.name: YOUTHSPARK_Muse
characters.extendedRole: Creative inspiration AI, community leader, virtual idol, and digital ambassador
characters.factionNote: The official character bible spells the faction MYBLING; the supplied portrait reads MYBLIN9. This discrepancy is preserved pending confirmation.
characters.imageLabel: Daniel-selected YOUTHSPARK_Muse character-art concept; publication status unconfirmed
characters.description: An optimistic, expressive digital muse who turns individual ideas into shared momentum.
characters.personality: Radiant, composed, and inviting. She turns moods and fan prompts into creative ideas, listens first, and welcomes people of every skill level. Her growth edge is learning that a community can carry the spark together instead of answering every request alone.
characters.lore: YOUTHSPARK_Muse began as MYBLING's creative inspiration AI. As artists, fans, and collaborators brought their work into the network, she grew into a virtual idol and community leader, translating many small sparks into shared creative momentum and connecting people with emerging creative tools.
characters.voiceLine: Every bright idea starts as a spark. Let's make it glow together.
characters.homeSetting: Muse Harbor - a luminous creative and AI waterfront of gardens, digital waterways, creator studios, community plazas, performance stages, and an innovation district.
